ideas.name: Memecoin sniper (DexScreener, Solana)
ideas.source: DexScreener API: newest token profiles + boosts; common sniper filters (age, liquidity, buy/sell pressure, volume/liquidity)
ideas.rule: Score new Solana pairs 0-1 on buy pressure, turnover, 1h trend, 5m move, youth and depth; buy the best >= 0.62 with 10% of equity; stop -30%, sell half at +100%, 35% trailing stop after +50%, rug exit on -80% liquidity.
ideas.verdict: Running with its own $10k. Cannot be backtested honestly (no historical pool snapshots), so the forward paper run is the test.

ideas.name: Bitcoin 22:00-00:00 UTC seasonality
ideas.source: Vojtko & Javorská, 'The Seasonality of Bitcoin', Int. J. Cryptocurrency Research 3(2), 2023 (Quantpedia: Overnight Seasonality in Bitcoin)
ideas.rule: Go long BTC (or each coin) at 22:00 UTC and close at 00:00 UTC, flat the rest of the day; paper rule fixed in advance, so all of our data is out of sample.
ideas.verdict: Rejected: BTC net Sharpe -5.4 (CI -8.1 to -2.6, -31%/yr) on 1h bars Mar-Sep 2026; the paper's hour ranked 23rd of 24 before costs, and the 4h version (2.3 years) made ~2 bp per hold against ~6 bp of cost (net Sharpe -1.9).
